sources.snippet: In this work, we propose a one-step diffusion-based VR model, termed as SeedVR2, which performs adversarial VR training against real data. To handle the challenging high-resolution VR within a single step, we introduce several enhancements to both model architecture and training procedures.

sources.title: SeedVR2: Image and video upscaling in ComfyUI - ComfyUI
sources.snippet: ComfyUI SeedVR2 Introduction SeedVR2 (arXiv:2506.05301, from ByteDance Seed) is a one-step diffusion-based video restoration model. It performs adversarial training against real data to restore and upscale images and videos with high fidelity. SeedVR2 is natively supported in ComfyUI (PR #14424).
